/wiki/File:Majestic_Theatre.jpg[The Phantom of the Opera](/wiki/The_Phantom_of_the_Opera_(1986_musical)) ran at the [Majestic Theatre](/wiki/Majestic_Theatre_(Broadway)) on [Broadway](/wiki/Broadway_theatre) from 1988 to 2023.
This is a list of [Broadway](/wiki/Broadway_theatre) shows with 1,000 or more performances, sorted by number of performances. Twelve shows currently running on Broadway have at least 1,000 performances: the 1996 revival of [Chicago](/wiki/Chicago_(musical)), [The Lion King](/wiki/The_Lion_King_(musical)), [Wicked](/wiki/Wicked_(musical)), [The Book of Mormon](/wiki/The_Book_of_Mormon_(musical)), [Aladdin](/wiki/Aladdin_(2011_musical)), [Hamilton](/wiki/Hamilton_(musical)), [Harry Potter and the Cursed Child](/wiki/Harry_Potter_and_the_Cursed_Child), [Hadestown](/wiki/Hadestown), [Moulin Rouge!](/wiki/Moulin_Rouge!_(musical)), [Six](/wiki/Six_(musical)), [MJ the Musical](/wiki/MJ_the_Musical), and [& Juliet](/wiki/%26_Juliet).

Unless otherwise noted, the run count listed is for the original Broadway production of the show. M denotes a [musical](/wiki/Musical_theatre), P denotes a [straight play](/wiki/Straight_play), R denotes [revue](/wiki/Revue), D denotes a dance show, and S denotes a special show or event. Bold titles indicate the show is currently running. Totals current through April 12, 2026.

## Timeline of longest-running Broadway shows
[[edit](/w/index.php?title=List_of_the_longest-running_Broadway_shows&action=edit&section=2)]

/wiki/File:Crookfinale.jpg[The Black Crook](/wiki/The_Black_Crook), which ran from 1866 to 1868, was the first Broadway show to run for over one year.[[128]](#cite_note-one_year-128)
This is a list of shows that have held the record for being the longest-running show (including straight plays and musicals) on [Broadway](/wiki/Broadway_theatre) since 1853. A few probable longest-running plays prior to 1853 are also listed.

Not included below is the 1976 revival of the revue [Oh! Calcutta!](/wiki/Oh!_Calcutta!), which briefly overtook [A Chorus Line](/wiki/A_Chorus_Line) as the Broadway show which had played the most performances, even though A Chorus Line had opened more than a year earlier and was still playing. Oh! Calcutta! achieved this distinction by playing more than the standard eight performances per week.[[129]](#cite_note-129) A Chorus Line retook the record for most performances after Oh! Calcutta! closed.

The longest running [off-Broadway](/wiki/Off-Broadway) musical to date is [The Fantasticks](/wiki/The_Fantasticks), which starred [Jerry Orbach](/wiki/Jerry_Orbach). When it closed on January 13, 2002, it had run for 42 years and 17,162 performances, making it the world's longest-running musical. The current longest-running musical on Broadway is [The Phantom of the Opera](/wiki/The_Phantom_of_the_Opera_(1986_musical)), which opened in 1988 and played its final performance in 2023.[[130]](#cite_note-130)

M denotes a [musical](/wiki/Musical_theatre) and P denotes a [straight play](/wiki/Straight_play).
